settings.field.default_browser: Browser Claude Code's render hook uses to open render results and the hub page — firefox/chrome/edge/safari or an absolute .app path
settings.field.browser_open: Whether Claude Code's render hook auto-opens the browser after a render — off=don't open, show the URL in chat only / background=open without stealing focus (open -g) / foreground=open and take focus
settings.field.browser_focus: [deprecated → browser_open] Whether Claude Code's render hook steals focus when opening the browser. Referenced only as a fallback when browser_open is unset
settings.field.browser_tab_reuse: Whether Claude Code's render hook reuses the existing fpm-hub named OS-browser tab when opening the /hub page — on=reuse it / off=new tab every time. ⚠️ OS browser tabs only — unrelated to hub's internal tab bar ('Render display mode'). Render results (..show/..ask) always open a new tab regardless
settings.field.render_target: Where Claude Code's render hook surfaces ..show render results — local-open=open the local file:// in an external browser / hub=open the hub server http URL in an external browser / vscode=no external browser; render into the VSCode Simple Browser panel (plus a chat URL fallback) / both=local-open plus the hub URL. Note: URL form (file:// vs http) and surface (external browser vs VSCode panel) are separate axes — only vscode changes the surface
settings.field.language: Language the hub server uses to render the hub UI — en(English, default)/ko(Korean). Applied on page reload after save
settings.field.feed_default_visible: Whether the feed sidebar starts expanded on first visit to the hub page
settings.field.live_session_limit: Max rows shown per active-session card on the hub page (0=unlimited)
settings.field.live_session_order: Sort order of active-session cards on the hub page — updated(recently updated)/created(creation)/project
settings.field.live_session_show_empty: Whether the hub page also shows empty live sessions that have no prompt yet (false=hidden)
settings.field.card_limit: Max htm render cards shown on the hub page (0=unlimited)
settings.field.search_limit: File cap per directory when the hub server rescans the disk (0=unlimited)
settings.field.feed_limit: Max items the hub server keeps and shows in the feed
settings.field.feed_show_project_emoji: Whether feed items on the hub page show the project emoji
settings.field.feed_show_project_name: Whether feed items on the hub page show the project name
settings.field.bind_host: Network interface the hub server listens on (127.0.0.1/0.0.0.0/IP). Server restart required on change
settings.field.advertise_host: Host Claude Code's render hook puts in hub|both URLs shown in chat (falls back to bind_host if omitted). Never omit this with bind_host=0.0.0.0
settings.field.feed_poll_interval: Interval at which the browser (hub page) re-polls the feed (sec, reference value)
settings.field.render_tab_mode: Where Claude Code render results open — browser-tab=new OS browser tab/window (default) / hub-internal=opens as an iframe in the internal tab bar at the top of the hub page (/hub-shell), no new OS tab. Pick hub-internal to use internal tabs. ⚠️ An already-open /hub-shell tab keeps behaving as internal tabs regardless of this mode — after switching to browser-tab, close that tab and open /hub instead. Fine-tuning (tab close shortcut, single window, lease TTL) lives in the Advanced tab
settings.field.tab_close_shortcut: Shortcut that closes an internal tab on the hub page ([ctrl+][alt+][shift+][meta+]<key>). ⚠️ ctrl+w/meta+w may be claimed by the browser
settings.field.hub_single_window: Whether the hub server forces one hub shell window per host (source-IP) — true=2nd window gets a takeover prompt / false=allow multiple windows
settings.field.hub_lease_ttl: Heartbeat expiry (sec) before the hub server reclaims a hub shell lease. Reclaimed when the browser's SSE keepalive is missed beyond this
settings.field.allow_server_list: hub server access gate by source-IP — true=allow the Servers.md whitelist+self / false=allow self (bind_host) only, block all external. Server restart required on change
settings.field.host_gate: hub access gate (by received name = Host header) — true (default) allows only bind_host / advertise_host / localhost / hostname(.local) / extra_hosts and rejects other names with 421 (DNS rebinding defense); false allows every name (legacy). IP literal Hosts always pass. Requires server restart
settings.field.ssh_remote_alias: SSH alias the hub server uses to answer a remote browser's open-project/open-session with a vscode-remote://ssh-remote+<alias> link (a Host name in the client's ~/.ssh/config, e.g. gl). Empty=disabled
